definition.P: survival probability exp(-Gamma N); Gamma = full width in units 1/L; N = T/L (static box held for T)
definition.lambda_c: lambda at mu = 1/L with Gamma(lambda_c) N = -ln P at fixed (g2, gY, y_t, g3) of the box
definition.interpolation: cubic spline of ln Gamma against x = |lambda|^(-1/2) through the narrow-resonance points (status ok / ok_broad); outside the computed range: linear extrapolation in x from the last three points (flag 'extrapolated', extrap_dx = distance in x)
